description: This file defines a repository class for managing purchase records in memory, including methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and filtering purchase data. It also initializes the repository with sample purchase data.

classes.name: PurchasesRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing purchase records with in-memory storage, supporting CRUD operations and filtering.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the data store and populates it with sample data.

methods.name: _initialize_sample_data(self)
methods.description: Private method that adds predefined sample purchase records to the repository.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create(self, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new purchase record with provided data and assigns an ID.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_by_id(self, item_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a purchase record by its ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_all(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Returns a list of all purchase records with optional pagination and filtering.

methods.name: int count(self, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Returns the count of purchase records, optionally filtered.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update(self, item_id: int, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates fields of a purchase record by its ID.

methods.name: bool delete(self, item_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a purchase record by its ID.
